title: SearXNG Widget Schema
description: Configuration schema for a self-hosted SearXNG instance with inline search results

serverUrl.label: SearXNG Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of your SearXNG instance (e.g. https://search.example.com). Instance must have format=json enabled and allow this origin in CORS settings.

defaultEngines.label: Default Engines (optional)
defaultEngines.description: Comma-separated engine names to use by default (e.g. google, bing). Leave empty to use SearXNG defaults.

categories.label: Categories (optional)
categories.description: Search categories to enable (e.g. general, news, images). Leave empty for the default category.
